## Linda Price
### Experienced Leadership. Proven Service. Putting People First.
One District...One Conversation...Every Community Matters
## About Linda Price
#### California State Senate, District 10
For a lifetime, Linda has helped organizations build stronger leaders, improve communication, & solve complex challenges. From supporting our nation's military to teaching future leaders & serving her community, Linda believes the best solutions emerge from listening.
MEET LINDA
DONATE
VOLUNTEER
Department of Defense
Supported the Army, Navy, & Air Force through organizational development.
Business Leader
Founded a successful organizational consultancy serving high-tech & other industries.
Educator
More than 30 years teaching leadership & management at Bay Area colleges.
Community Volunteer
League of Women Voters, Rotary Club, Elks Lodge, and decades of civic service.
Read Linda's Story
## LEADERSHIP
## INTEGRITY
## SERVICE
## COLLABORATION
## Why Linda Is Running
As I've traveled throughout Senate District 10, I've met people from every walk of life. We share many of the same hopes: safe neighborhoods, quality schools, affordable housing, a healthy economy, opportunities for our children, & a government that is accountable to the people it serves.
That's why I'm running.
I want to bring integrity, professionalism, practical experience, & common sense to Sacramento while ensuring every community has a voice. The issues we face & opportunities to embrace are not Democrat or Republican issues. They are California issues & opportunities!
I am not a local politician. I am not a career politician. My commitment to you is simple.
I'll listen before I speak.
I'll treat every person with respect.
I'll work hard.
I'll tell you the truth, even when the answers aren't easy.
And I'll never forget that public office is about serving people—not politics.
One District...One Conversation...Every Community Matters.
